cue.unanchored_tv: TV or monitor not fixed to the wall or stand
cue.unanchored_dresser: Dresser or tall furniture not anchored to the wall
cue.uncovered_outlet: Outlets without covers within a child's reach
cue.stairs_no_gate: Stairs with no gate at the top or bottom
cue.open_water_container: Buckets or containers with standing water
cue.cleaning_products_low: Cleaning products stored below counter height
cue.small_objects_floor: Small objects on the floor or low surfaces
cue.crib_loose_items: Blankets, pillows or toys in the crib
cue.stove_knobs_front: Stove knobs on the front where a child can turn them
cue.appliance_cord_hanging: Appliance cords hanging over the counter edge
cue.window_low_no_guard: Low windows that open with no guard or stop
cue.heavy_items_high_shelf: Heavy items on high shelves or the top of furniture
cue.power_strip_floor_reach: Power strips or cords on the floor within reach
cue.pot_handle_outward: Pot handles sticking out over the edge of the stove
cue.hot_items_counter_edge: Hot drinks or dishes near the counter edge
cue.bath_faucet_exposed: Bath faucet that a child can reach or that runs very hot
cue.car_seat_loose_install: Car seat that moves more than an inch at the belt path
cue.car_seat_harness_slack: Car seat harness loose or straps twisted
cue.garage_chemicals_low: Chemicals or fuel stored low in the garage
cue.garage_tools_reach: Tools or sharp items within reach in the garage
cue.pool_unfenced: Pool without a fence and self-latching gate
cue.hot_tub_uncovered: Hot tub or spa without a locked cover
cue.standing_water_in_tub: Water left standing in the bathtub
cue.infant_non_crib_sleep_surface: Baby sleeping on a sofa, adult bed or soft surface
cue.button_battery_accessible: Button batteries in loose devices or remotes
cue.loose_magnets_accessible: Small magnets a child can pick up
cue.laundry_packets_accessible: Laundry or dishwasher packets within reach
cue.furniture_near_window: Furniture a child could climb next to a window
